Differing lines:

- `proposals/decision/2026-11-26-flush-within-5-ms/proposal.md`

- `proposals/decision/2026-11-26-flush-within-50-ms/proposal.md`
  - line 2: `id: decision/2026-11-26-flush-within-50-ms`
  - line 5: `title: Flush within 50 ms`
  - line 31: `target_source: src/b.rs`
  - line 40: `# Flush within 50 ms`

Both records have `status: draft`, reference `SEED-1`, and carry the same empty template body. They are two competing decisions on the same question, with a 10x difference in the flush deadline (5 ms vs 50 ms). Their front matter and bodies don't say which one is intended, and neither body records any evidence, rationale, or alternatives. Since both are drafts, one of them probably needs to be superseded or withdrawn before either is landed. I haven't changed either record.
